description: From observed grades, the grades-to-maximum principle, the genus principle, actuality only insofar as being and excluded middle: some being is maximal in esse (weak IsMaximumIn) and causes esse in every other being having esse. STMT-MOST-TRUE-IS-MOST-BEING is not a premise. Grades of truth supply only a being having esse; any respect with grades would do. In the case with a comparison above a being having esse, the maximum principle at esse carries the maximum. In the flat case, with no such comparison, that being is vacuously maximal and the principle at esse is unused; flatBranch shows the genus principle and cause-more-such then leave at most one being having esse. MoreIn does not entail InAct (flatMaximum), so the maximum does not presuppose grades of being. The witness is not shown to be maximally true, and the theorem is not attributed to Aquinas, whose text passes through truth. Supplementary closed obligations: actualFork and actualCore are the population-relative split and its exclusion; unboundedGivesAmongActual connects the certified fork's unbounded predicate to that horn; truthBridgeNotEntailed has one Boolean interpretation of the other nonlogical premises and the conclusion with the truth bridge false; withoutActuality and withoutApproach have the conclusion false with the named premise deleted; withoutGrades has the maximum principle and actuality true, grades false and no maximum in esse on an empty carrier. Fixtures concern encoded satisfiability, not metaphysical possibility. Every premise remains open. flatBranch and flatMaximum are also closed obligations.
